answers.description: Koda Streetwear offers a unique blend of urban fashion, focusing on limited edition drops that resonate with the vibrant culture of streetwear enthusiasts.
answers.uniqueSellingPoint: Exclusive designs that reflect the local culture and street style.
answers.goals: To become a leading streetwear brand in Papua New Guinea and expand into international markets.
